description: Earlier attempts in this repair task, preserved independently from the final successful execution. TEST-CLOSURE-01 is archived separately.

results.name: First location without state
results.expected: Commit version 1, create state and publish pointer atomically.

results.name: Version numbering and current pointer
results.expected: Successive accepted writes produce versions 1 and 2, matching pointers and one revision increment per publication.

results.name: Explicit expected revision
results.expected: Reject missing/invalid expected revision; accept explicit ABSENT only for absent state and exact token for existing state.

results.name: Stale transaction
results.expected: Reject stale revision/current-pointer command without appending history or changing state.

results.name: Simultaneous first-location writers
results.expected: Observe rival blocked before releasing winner; exactly one first publication and stale loser.

results.name: Simultaneous pointer updates
results.expected: Observe rival blocked before releasing winner; exactly one new publication and stale loser.

results.name: Actual lock contention
results.expected: Record both backend PIDs, pg_blocking_pids, Lock wait type and positive ungranted-lock count before release.

results.name: Duplicate operation and idempotent retry
results.expected: Exact retry returns original outcome without duplicate history, revision increment or repointing.

results.name: Same operation with different payload
results.expected: Reject changed payload under existing operation ID; preserve history and state.

results.name: Delayed geocoding result
results.expected: Reject synthetic delayed command after input/revision/pointer changes; no provider calls.

results.name: Former owner or changed parent
results.expected: Reject former-owner and deleted-parent commands; do not recreate parent or publish history.

results.name: Failure after history insertion
results.expected: Injected failure rolls back inserted history and any newly created state.

results.name: Failure after pointer update
results.expected: Injected failure rolls back history, pointer, revision and timestamps.

results.name: Complete rollback including COMMIT failure
results.expected: Observe actual COMMIT rejection with SQLSTATE and verify complete rollback; never acknowledge success before COMMIT.
